source: documented steady-sine truth, pupu Xone path (out 3 -> in 5 re loopback out 2 -> in 2), 2026-10-07: docs/rigs/pupu.md 'REW cross-check, electrical' and docs/design/subsample-arrival-group-delay.md. level_note: the hand scripts played amplitude 10^(L/20)*sqrt(2): their '-30 dBFS' is -27 dBFS in the full-scale-sine convention ac2 and REW use, 3 dB hotter than the -30 dBFS sweeps compared with it
floor_note: per-bin noise -108 dBr in a 2 s Blackman FFT; over the 7-bin main lobe about -99.5 dBr, used as the floor of every documented harmonic
